description: Add a record (entry) to a data model. Pass the model id or slug and a `data` object whose keys are the model's field keys (use get_model first if unsure). Only call AFTER you described the record and the user explicitly agreed; never create without that go-ahead.

data.description: Field values keyed by the model's field keys. A translatable field (localized: true on the model) takes a language map, e.g. { title: { en: 'Ball bearing', pl: 'Łożysko' } }

modelIdOrSlug.description: The target model's id or slug (from list_models)

name: create_record
